note: THE ONE SOURCE for the facilitator's City Events: ten city-wide events, five GOOD and five BAD, fired by one press of ACTIVATE on the Admin Control Panel. They are not faults: no procedure, no code, no card on ACTIVE FAULTS. Edit here and nowhere else — the control panel reads these through the control frame and prints the effect line that lib/city-events.js derives from `effects`, so no number is typed twice. Effect kinds are the specification's words; the engine maps each onto something it already has: health → setIntegrity (a gain never revives a DARK sector), injure_workers → injure(), extra_workers → the extra_workers effect availableWorkers reads, trn_capacity → the trn_capacity effect trnCapacity reads, med_healing_capacity → the med_capacity effect medCapacity reads, upkeep_modifier → the upkeep_extra obligation upkeepFor adds and the economy pass retires. Targets: ALL_SECTORS, ALL_NON_DARK_SECTORS, or a sector code. `expires: round` ends with the round; `cycles_remaining: 1` is consumed by the next upkeep actually processed.

repeat_policies.ONCE_PER_ROUND: the same event cannot be activated again in the same round
repeat_policies.BLOCK_WHILE_PENDING: the same event cannot be activated again while an effect it created is still pending

events.name: CITY SYSTEMS STABILISED
events.description: Core oscillation has temporarily stabilised. System stress across HAVEN-9 is decreasing.
events.player_message: CITY SYSTEMS STABILISED — All operating sectors recover 10 Health.
rules: Do not revive a DARK sector.
DARK sectors remain at 0 Health and still require the existing Emergency Restart process.
Health may not exceed 100.

events.name: TRANSPORT CORRIDOR CLEARED
events.description: Maintenance crews have reopened an abandoned freight corridor.
events.player_message: TRANSPORT CORRIDOR CLEARED — TRN receives 2 additional transfer approvals this round.
rules: Do not reset approvals already used.
Increase the maximum allowance for the current round only.
Expire automatically when the round changes.

events.name: EMERGENCY MAINTENANCE CREW
events.description: Reserve maintenance personnel have been released to support city operations.
events.player_message: EMERGENCY MAINTENANCE CREW — Every operating sector receives 1 additional Worker this round.
rules: Use the existing temporary-worker effect.
Do not permanently increase starting workforce.
Temporary capacity disappears automatically at round change.
Expiry never creates negative available Workers.

events.name: UTILITY RESERVE RELEASED
events.description: Emergency electrical reserves have been released to reduce the city's operating burden.
events.player_message: UTILITY RESERVE RELEASED — Every sector requires 1 less Power at its next upkeep.
rules: The modifier appears immediately in each sector's NEXT UPKEEP display.
It applies to the next upkeep actually processed, then goes.
A requirement never falls below zero.

events.name: CITY RECOVERY PROTOCOL
events.description: Emergency medical and engineering protocols have been authorised across HAVEN-9.
events.player_message: CITY RECOVERY PROTOCOL — All operating sectors recover 5 Health. MED receives 2 additional heals this round.
rules: Do not revive DARK sectors.
Do not automatically heal Workers: MED still chooses who to heal.
Only MED receives the increased healing allowance, and it expires at round change.

events.name: MONSTER ATTACK
events.description: Hostile creatures have breached HAVEN-9's outer tunnel network. Casualties and structural damage are reported across the city.
events.player_message: MONSTER ATTACK — All sectors lose 10 Health. 1 Worker is injured in every sector.
rules: Use the existing Worker injury pipeline: the injured Worker appears in the existing injured-worker system and MED's healing rules apply.
A sector with no Worker to injure injures none; counts never go negative.
Health may fall to 0 and trigger the normal DARK behaviour.

events.name: TUNNEL NETWORK DAMAGE
events.description: Structural damage has closed one of HAVEN-9's main logistics corridors.
events.player_message: TUNNEL NETWORK DAMAGE — TRN loses 1 transfer approval this round.
rules: Never revoke transfers already approved.
If approvals used already meet the new capacity, only further approvals are prevented.
Capacity never becomes negative; the effect expires at the next round change.

events.name: CORE ENERGY INSTABILITY
events.description: Core instability is increasing electrical demand across all station systems.
events.player_message: CORE ENERGY INSTABILITY — Every sector requires 1 additional Power at its next upkeep.
rules: The increased cost shows immediately in NEXT UPKEEP.
It applies once, to the next upkeep actually processed, then goes.

events.name: CITYWIDE STRUCTURAL DAMAGE
events.description: A subterranean tremor has damaged work areas throughout HAVEN-9.
events.player_message: CITYWIDE STRUCTURAL DAMAGE — All sectors lose 5 Health and operate with 1 fewer Worker this round.
rules: This is NOT an injury event: no Worker goes to MED.
The lost Worker capacity returns automatically at the next round.
Available Workers never fall below 0; Health may reach 0 and use the normal DARK behaviour.

events.name: EMERGENCY LOCKDOWN
events.description: Multiple containment alarms have triggered an Authority-wide emergency lockdown.
events.player_message: EMERGENCY LOCKDOWN — All sectors lose 5 Health. TRN loses 1 transfer approval and MED loses 1 healing capacity this round.
rules: Approvals and heals already completed are not undone; only future actions are blocked.
Health may reach 0 and use the normal DARK behaviour.
Both capacity modifiers expire at the next round.
